backlog.title: Fix six end-to-end validation defects (BUG-001..BUG-006) and restore spec compliance
backlog.description: Creative validation of hapax against the PRD found six real defects: (1) threshold mode preempts stock slash/@/quoted-path completion and Tab in a slash context opens the hapax menu (violates the acceptance-critical 'Tab never opens the menu' invariant and §09 item 6); (2) the admission-band retune (50/20) rejects national/energy/laboratory making the PRD's M2 acceptance scenario (item 7) unreachable; (3) sub-16-char, <=1-digit fragments of pasted secrets pass every gate and are offered as completions (§09 item 5, 'never embarrass'); (4) astral-plane letters before an ASCII run leak the remainder (𝔘sword -> 'sword', §04 rule 3); (5) an armed chain swallows the trigger char and returns a mis-prefixed successor set (§07 state machine); (6) the bigram map can sit above its 10k hard cap after one large message (§06). This phase fixes all six with research-grounded, test-first changes in src/pi/provider.ts, src/core/score.ts, src/core/shapeGate.ts, src/pi/ingest.ts, src/core/segment.ts, src/core/store.ts, plus regression re-verification and documentation sync. Research findings live in plan/002_3e8a42cadf2c/bugfix/001_0f4b641cf9ce/architecture/. Guardrails: spec/*.md is READ-ONLY (product spec); tests import constants from src, never hard-code; providers must pass the options object through unchanged on delegation.

milestones.title: Provider integration correctness (BUG-001, BUG-005)
milestones.description: Make hapax a strict overlay on stock pi completion: slash-command, @-mention, quoted-path and unquoted-path contexts always delegate to current.getSuggestions with options passed through unchanged (fixing both the typing-path preemption and the Tab-opens-menu path in slash contexts), and the armed chain resets to idle when a non-word-start char (notably the trigger char) precedes the typed fragment so trigger mode wins with the correct consumed prefix.

tasks.title: Stock-context classifier and delegation in getSuggestions (BUG-001)
tasks.description: Add an exported pure classifier for stock-owned contexts (slash command, @-mention, quoted path, unquoted path) mirroring pi-tui's own detection, and gate createHapaxProvider.getSuggestions on it BEFORE the armed-chain branch, delegating to current.getSuggestions with the options object passed through unchanged. This simultaneously fixes: (a) typing '/re', '@me', '"src/roun' showing hapax's word menu instead of stock items; (b) the force:false+explicitTab slash-context Tab path returning a multi-item hapax set that OPENS the menu on a single Tab (the pi-tui single-item fast path at editor.js:1902 requires force:true, which slash Tab never sends) and a second Tab corrupting the command line.

tasks.title: Armed-chain trigger-char reset and correct prefix consumption (BUG-005)
tasks.description: While a word is armed, typing the trigger char plus a fragment ('x alphaone #b') must reset the chain to idle and let trigger mode answer with prefix '#b' (trigger char consumed), instead of filtering successors at prefix 'b' which leaves the '#' in the buffer after blind prefix-length deletion.

subtasks.title: Require word-start fragments in the armed branch; reset + fall through otherwise
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See architecture/provider-tui-integration.md — the armed branch (src/pi/provider.ts ~296-330) runs BEFORE extractMatchState; its fragment regex /[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/ matches 'b' after '#' without requiring a word start, so the chain swallows the trigger char. pi-tui's stock applyCompletion deletes exactly prefix.length chars blindly, so a prefix of 'b' for text '#b' leaves '#betaword'.
2. INPUT: armed ChainState {word} from createChainMachine(); the delegation gate from P1.M1.T1.S2 already ahead of this branch; config.triggerChar / config.enableChaining.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §Minor Issue 2 (h3.4) recommendation: in the armed-branch fragment path, require the matched fragment to sit at a word start (before.length - frag.length === 0 || /[ \t]/.test(before[before.length - frag.length - 1])). If NOT at a word start (trigger char, punctuation, '/', etc. glued before the fragment) -> chain.reset() and fall through to the normal path (stock-context gate then extractMatchState) so trigger mode wins with prefix triggerChar+fragment. Zero-typed-char offer (before === '' || /[ \t]$/) and normal filtering ('x alphaone be') unchanged. TDD in test/chain.test.ts following its existing patterns: session with successors alphaone->betaword/deltaword; arm via applyCompletion; line 'x alphaone #b' => trigger-mode items, prefix '#b', chain.state() null; 'x alphaone be' still filters successors at prefix 'be'; zero-char offer regression. Mock: none beyond the standard store/config fixtures used by chain.test.ts.
4. OUTPUT: Corrected armed-branch semantics in src/pi/provider.ts consumed by P1.M1.T2.S2 (editor-sim verification).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] none — internal state-machine fix; no user-facing/config surface beyond behavior already covered by final docs task.

milestones.title: Admission and secret-defense correctness (BUG-002, BUG-003)
milestones.description: Make the PRD's own M2 acceptance phrase (National -> Renewable -> Energy -> Laboratory at zero typed chars) reachable again without reintroducing common-word menu noise, via a capitalized-occurrence (proper-noun) admission relief band validated by the §09 tuning protocol and pinned in an automated test; and close the secret-fragment leak by lowering the raw-text bare-run mask floor to 32 and propagating whole-token secret rejection to its sub-word drafts, verified against the PRD's paste battery.

tasks.title: Proper-noun admission relief so the M2 acceptance phrase admits and chains (BUG-002)
tasks.description: The 50/20 band retune rejects national (q=90), energy (q=94), laboratory (q=57) so the NREL phrase never enters the store and integration item 7 is unreachable. A blanket retune (REJECT >= 95) would re-admit lowercase context (51)/posts (47) and break the calibration no-menu suite. Fix: whole-token-only relief band admitting shape-valid capitalized (properName) rank-rejected words below a ceiling constant (default 120: > 94 so the phrase admits, <= 156 so The/This/With/Them stay rejected), validated with the tuning protocol and pinned by an automated end-to-end acceptance test.

tasks.title: Code-point-correct Unicode boundary guard in tokenize (BUG-004)
tasks.description: isUniLetter reads codePointAt one code unit at a time, so an astral (surrogate-pair) letter immediately BEFORE a match is seen as its lone low surrogate and the run slips through: tokenize('𝔘sword') -> ['sword'] while §04 rule 3 requires nothing.

subtasks.title: Fix the before-side boundary check to step by full code points at both guard sites
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See architecture/core-engine-findings.md — isUniLetter (src/core/segment.ts:78-83) takes a code point; guard sites at :130-131 (base pass) and :152-155 (hexish pass) call isUniLetter(text.codePointAt(m.index - 1)). For an astral letter before a match, codePointAt at that offset returns the lone LOW surrogate (0xDC00-0xDFFF), which is not \p{L}. The AFTER side is already correct (codePointAt at a high surrogate returns the full pair). The function's own JSDoc documents this as an 'Accepted v1 trade-off' — the PRD demotes it to a spec deviation.
2. INPUT: tokenize(text) in src/core/segment.ts; UNI_LETTER_RE (/\p{L}/u) and ASCII_LETTER_RE constants; RawToken output shape.
3. LOGIC: Implement PRD §Minor Issue 1 (h3.3): add a helper (e.g. isUniLetterBefore(text, index)) that, when the code unit at index-1 is a low surrogate, backs up one more unit and tests the combined code point; use it at BOTH before-side guard sites (base and hexish passes); keep the after-side logic unchanged. TDD in test/segment.test.ts: tokenize('𝔘sword') -> []; tokenize('sword𝔘') -> [] (regression, already passing); 'ΩbsidianMirror' -> []; 'Þórhildur' -> []; BMP 'é' adjacency both sides still disqualifies; an astral letter between two ASCII runs kills both; hexish variant with astral prefix. Remove the 'Accepted v1 trade-off' JSDoc limitation note. Mock: none (pure function).
4. OUTPUT: Correct tokenize() in src/core/segment.ts; consumed by P1.M4.T1.S1 regression and the final docs task (README known-limitations sweep).

tasks.title: Drain the bigram map to within cap in the same recordBigramRuns call (BUG-006)
tasks.description: #evictBigramsIfOverCap pops at most BIGRAM_EVICT_BATCH=256 victims per recordBigramRuns call (once per message), so one message with >10,256 distinct bigrams leaves the map over the documented 10,000-key hard cap indefinitely.

Measured: one 11,000-bigram message left bigramSize at 10,714.
2. INPUT: recordBigramRuns(runs: readonly string[][]) and #evictBigramsIfOverCap() internals in src/core/store.ts; bigramSize getter; test/bigrams.test.ts cap-test conventions.

LOGIC: Implement PRD §Minor Issue 3 (h3.5) recommendation (code fix, not spec documentation): wrap the 256-pop batch in a do/while (or equivalent) so #evictBigramsIfOverCap returns only when this.#bigrams.size <= BIGRAM_CAP — keep the inner batch constant for heap pacing and stale-node hygiene. TDD in test/bigrams.test.ts: build text of 11,000 distinct rare-pair lines ('v<i>a v<i>b'), one processText through the real pipeline, assert store.bigramSize <= 10_000 IMMEDIATELY (no further messages); assert eviction still uses the standard policy (lowest bigramSortKey first — reuse existing assertions); perf sanity: ingest-time budget for the 11k case stays far under the 3x perf-gate ceiling.
